limitations.statement: Population and exact-zero n/T gates inspect stored t_eval states; coefficient evaluation additionally restricts temperatures at evaluated RHS/diagnostic points. This is not a proof of all hidden BDF accepted-state bounds. The n/T zero subspace is algebraically invariant for the selected zero-flux initial condition.

The 1200s campaign allocation is enforced for the current invocation, with cooperative 240s per-case/deadline checks. Restarting the command resets its timer; any resumed campaign must use the remaining allocation rather than claim a fresh cumulative budget. Serialization may finish between cooperative checks.
Source identity and finite energy residuals verify the selected equations, not missing-process adequacy, full cosmic thermal self-consistency, production readiness or global convergence.
Mao-factor times unchanged donor alpha is a named hybrid; empirical rate differentiation defines a different conditional fit-implied moment. Their difference is not a total-error or confidence bound.

Prompt escape of Li core energy and local thermalization of the primary electron are conditional closures. Multiple photoionization, excitation, transfer, nonthermal secondary, collisional and nuclear energy owners remain unresolved.
